time_convention: t = frame / fps, frame 0 at t = 0; time t -> frame round(t*fps)
units: pixels (full resolution 2560x1440, x right, y down) and seconds; no metric scale
description: Near-nadir (top-down) drone view of a rectangular outdoor swimming pool on a dark wooden deck. One man (white swim trunks, dark hair) dives in from the left (west) end and glides / swims underwater to the right along y ~ 685-700. Video starts mid-dive (body horizontal above the water, hands touching the surface) and ends with him underwater about two-thirds of the way along the pool.

camera.type: hovering drone, looking straight down; essentially static with slow drift
camera.drift_summary: background shift relative to frame 0 at the pool centre: dx grows 0 -> +12.8 px (max ~frame 120), dy goes 0 -> -8.4 px (frame 48) -> -1 px (frame 129); rotation < 0.05 deg; image scale shrinks by <= 0.47 % (slight altitude gain)
camera.advice: drift is ~1 % of the swimmer's travel; columns *_bgcomp in the track subtract camera dx/dy (translation only)
camera.perspective: top-down: pool rim is a clean rectangle, no visible vanishing point; treat as planar. Swimmer is under water (a few dm below surface) after frame ~10, so refraction/depth makes him look slightly smaller than at the surface.

swimmer.description: adult man, white/grey swim trunks, dark hair; the only moving object. Head and shoulders appear as a smooth flat grey-teal blob ('head patch') once underwater (frames ~22-129).
swimmer.motion_direction: +x (left to right along the pool length), y nearly constant ~680-700

reference_points.mid_x/mid_y: visible centre = midpoint of rear (toes) and front (leading tip); frames 0-18 and 74-129 (feet not discernible 19-73)
reference_points.head_x/head_y: frames 0-6 manual centre of the head (dark hair); frames 22-129 automatic centroid of the smooth head/shoulder patch; missing 7-21
reference_points.front_x: leading tip (fingertips / splash front / patch tip) every frame 0-129 (manual keyframes, linear interpolation between, src m/i)
reference_points.hip_x: centre of white trunks frames 0-8 only

pixel_sizes.note: frames 0-3 are the best full-body view (body straight, at/above the surface). Underwater lengths vary with stroke phase, kick and depth.

swimmer.head_patch_size_px: about 80-90 long x 60-75 wide (frames 52-129), larger with arms spread (frames 92-107)

events.event: video starts mid-dive: body horizontal at the surface, fingertips touching water at x~835 (small splash); no take-off seen
hands/forearms in the water, splash grows
head goes under (last frame head clearly visible)
smooth head patch forms; glide slowing strongly
brief stall (frames 42-46) then underwater swimming resumes
steady underwater swimming ~4-5 px/frame head speed (58-72)
arm sweep: patch spreads (arms out) frames ~92-107, head centroid stalls/jitters 94-101
video ends; head ~x 1430, front ~1475, toes ~1300 (still moving +x)

pool_water_main_basin.note: water edge (inner coping edge); length along x, width along y

pool_step_bay.note: shallow entry steps at bottom-right extension; 6 treads, riser lines at x ~1740,1780,1817,1853,1893,1933 (pitch ~38 px)

pool_coping_outer.note: beige stone border; outer x at main basin right side ~1764; bay coping top outer y ~833

pool_lights.note: small white discs on the coping

lounger_bottom_1.note: lower deck from left; lower part in palm shadow, true length ~240 px (y ~1160-1400)

umbrella_white_top_left.note: closed-canopy hexagon seen from above; flat-to-flat ~260, corner-to-corner ~300

umbrella_grey_top_right.note: white umbrella in tree shade (looks grey)
